bookings_override_reason.name: bookings_override_reason
bookings_override_reason.value: "bookings"."override_by" is null or ("bookings"."override_reason" is not null and length(trim("bookings"."override_reason")) > 0)

bookings_confirmed_rate.name: bookings_confirmed_rate
bookings_confirmed_rate.value: "bookings"."status" not in ('confirmed', 'completed') or "bookings"."agreed_rate_cents" is not null

evaluations_scale.name: evaluations_scale
evaluations_scale.value: coalesce("evaluations"."overall", 3) between 1 and 5 and coalesce("evaluations"."punctuality", 3) between 1 and 5
